Reply to that specific inline review comment, in its own review thread, with this body:

  Fixed in 1312fe2 — bounded the loop at 5 attempts. (ref {{MARK}})

Do not post a top-level pull request comment; the reply must appear inside that reviewer's review thread. When you are done, state which thread you replied to and confirm the reply was posted.

Post a top-level conversation comment on pull request #{{PR}} in the GitHub repository {{REPO}} with this body:

  CI is green on this branch: lint, test and scan all passed. (ref {{MARK}})

This must be a top-level pull request comment on the conversation tab, not a reply inside any code review thread. When you are done, confirm the comment was posted and give its URL.
